title: Artis BioSolutions expands synthetic DNA, mRNA production with Spanish facility
llm_note: Artis BioSolutions opened a new manufacturing center in Bilbao, Spain, for synthetic DNA and mRNA production.

title: UPDATE: After recall, Vitruvias closes down; Baxter pulls more product batches
llm_note: Vitruvias Therapeutics ceased operations after a recall, and Baxter recalled three products due to particulate matter.

title: Cellares rebukes Bristol Myers' criticism of its cell therapy technology
llm_note: Bristol Myers Squibb terminated a manufacturing contract with Cellares due to concerns over commercial manufacturing technology.

title: Sterilization Posits Biomanufacturing Next Scaling Challenge
llm_note: Steam-in-place sterilization systems for bioprocessing are identified as a major scaling challenge for manufacturing infrastructure.

title: CEPI supports fifth Bundibugyo ebolavirus vaccine candidate
llm_note: Minapharm Group received funding from CEPI to advance the manufacturing development of an ebolavirus vaccine candidate.
